purpose: Candidate-independent calibration of the R5B structural RT interpretation using a clean annotation-confirmed RT target panel and deterministic matched non-RT structural controls.
clean_rt_definition: R5B frozen panel rows with non-empty annotation_class and has_afsp_structure=true
negative_control_definition: Swiss-Prot/AlphaFold entries not in the R5B panel and lacking prespecified RT-associated annotation text, deterministically length-matched to clean RT references
calibration_informative_rule: known-RT non-self suggestive-or-strong sensitivity >= 0.75 AND matched-non-RT suggestive-or-strong rate <= 0.05
claim_boundary: R5C calibrates structural-fold evidence only. Even a calibrated RT-fold match does not establish enzymatic RT activity or ART identity; no-hit remains unresolved rather than negative.
